// diagnostic L0309

Jet.StaticOnlyStruct

`{name}` has no fields, and every function in it is static

What

`{name}` has no fields, and every function in it is static

Why

No value of `{name}` carries anything and no function here takes or returns one, so the struct only groups functions under a type name, which is what a module is for

Fix

Replace `{name}: struct` with a `name: module { … }` block holding the same functions, and call them through the module's name

Worked example
